description: We are ITIan, a team of AI & ML students at ITI in Egypt, taking part in NASA Space Apps Cairo 2026. Our shared skills are Python, machine learning, and presenting complex ideas clearly. We chose the challenge “Be an Earth System Trend Detective” and are building Trendoscope: a tool that uses NASA Earth data to show whether a change, such as in rainfall or temperature, is real or just random. We are excited to build, learn, and share our project with the Cairo community and globally.
